evidence_class: official documentation, distinct from original-image static contracts and runtime observation

sources.title: Importing Media
sources.short_quote: Files that have a different sample rate than the project sample rate are played back at the wrong speed and pitch.
sources.claim: The documented ordinary workflow does not promise automatic transparent rate conversion for an unconverted file.

sources.title: Project Setup Dialog
sources.claim: Project sample rate governs recording and playback. Changing it after audio exists requires file conversion for proper playback; supported internal hardware settings are changed to match, while external clock mismatches can be accepted.

sources.title: Import Options Dialog for Audio Files
sources.claim: Import can convert differing sample rate or bit depth to project settings and can copy files into the project. Those are file-import choices, not a universal live resampling contract.

hypothesis_revision: Prior APP016/APP017 work correctly withheld arbitrary differing-rate placement but sought possible source/project reconciliation. Do not require a hypothetical transparent live conformer as the only faithful resolution: the direct raw-reader path and documented changed speed/pitch are mutually consistent. Test the concrete builder, reader, source and output-rate relationships, including saved clip duration/offset and positive short-read failure semantics.
limits: Documentation is not observed runtime behavior and does not specify exact frame arithmetic, EOF behavior, saved CPR rate ownership, backend choice or all processed/warp/scrub branches.
No existing conversion mode is reclassified as the ordinary native path. Explicit file conversion and unconverted timeline reading remain distinct.
